description: Declared purpose and retention metadata for PS-019 TC-303 prototype. Missing entries are evidence gaps requiring human review — they are NOT legal violation findings.

gap_design_notes.complete: Fields with declared purpose and retention period present
gap_design_notes.purpose_missing: Fields with declared retention period but missing purpose
gap_design_notes.retention_missing: Fields with declared purpose but missing retention period
gap_design_notes.both_missing: Metadata record exists but both purpose and retention are explicitly null/missing
gap_design_notes.not_mapped: Discovered candidate fields with no metadata entry in this configuration
